macd.condition: on the same closed 4H candle MACD line crosses below MACD signal line; previous candle MACD line was >= its signal

strategy.entry: next 4H candle open after the qualifying candle closes
strategy.stop: 1.5 * ATR(14) from signal candle close, fixed from actual next-open entry
strategy.funding: Use actual historical/current OKX funding timestamps and rates for the simulated SHORT; never assume missing funding is zero.

safety: Exploratory virtual-only paper simulation; it is not evidence that the strategy is profitable or validated.
The simulator uses public OKX market and funding data only and has no order-placement code.
Never connect this simulator to real order endpoints or real account credentials.
Do not modify production bot.py or .github/workflows/bot.yml.
Do not send messages to the production Telegram chat from this simulator.
BTC and ETH are simulated independently with a virtual 10 USDT notional per position.
